Name: Modest Maps Beach Farm
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6![/b]

REQUIRES:
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Yep. That's it.
[/list]

OVERVIEW:
The Modest Island Map is a redesigned Island Farm, meant to capitalize on the space provided with the vanilla map, with a few tweaks here and there for added support.

[list]
[*]Slightly Larger landmass.
[*]Sprinklers work on sand!!!
[*]Grass Field that can grow crops. (Just swing a hoe!~)
[*]Grass grows seasonal forage.
[*]Beach gathers shells and other forage.
[/list]

SIDE NOTES:
If you like my work or have found an issue, I'd love for you to let me know in the POSTS! This is the first mod I've ever posted to the nexus, or put so much effort into, so I'd appreciate the support!


INSTALLATION:
Download the file.
Extract the Folder.
Put said folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
Load with SMAPI.
Enjoy.



[quote]The Ye' Old snapshots were using Vibrant Pastoral Recolor by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91802318]grapeponta[/url]. It's got some issues now, but there is a 1.6 fix for it out as a separate mod! 10/10 best reshade IMO.[/quote]
